PRIVACY_SHEET_INTRO: We do not sell your data. We do not use your focus intentions or reflections for ads or personality scoring. v1.0.0 is built to work on your device — core practice does not require an account or cloud AI. No ads in this practice space.
PRIVACY_SHEET_FULL_LEAD: Below is the full privacy notice for Focus Tiger (plain language), aligned with our published policy.
PRIVACY_SHEET_SEC_1_TITLE: 1. How AI inference handles your input
PRIVACY_SHEET_AI_INFERENCE: AI companion features related to habits, check-ins, and practice guidance run on your device. Related inputs are processed on your device and are not sent to a third-party large language model provider.
PRIVACY_SHEET_DEFAULT_STORAGE: Unless you use export/import yourself, habit check-ins and practice records stay on your device by default. This app does not automatically upload them to our servers.
PRIVACY_SHEET_EXPORT_IMPORT: You can export and import a local backup file (plain JSON, not encrypted). Scope: Journey Log, practice calendar, milestone markers, permanent ownership marks, advanced ritual completions, and the Mustard Seed seal. Not included: reflection journal entries, Confide conversations, Yin personal memory, preferences, or ambient music uploads.
PRIVACY_SHEET_NOT_DO: What we do not do in v1.0.0: no account login for the core loop; no crash SDK and no analytics by default (optional anonymous support-funnel counts only if you turn them on below).
PRIVACY_SHEET_CLOUD: This app does not currently offer cloud backup. If we add it later, we will update this notice first, keep it off by default, explain what is stored and whether it is encrypted, and ask for your consent.
PRIVACY_SHEET_RIGHTS: You may delete local data anytime (in-app reset or uninstall). You may export your practice backup file anytime. Questions: hello@twinsology.com
PRIVACY_SHEET_CLOSING: Use ? for a short introduction to this space. Export and import controls are on this sheet.
PRIVACY_SHEET_WELLNESS_NOTE: This is a practice space, not clinical care.
PRIVACY_SHEET_WELLNESS_LINK: Read: Not therapy or medical care
PRIVACY_SHEET_WELLNESS_LINK_ARIA: Open the not-therapy notice on the introduction card
PRIVACY_SHEET_YPE_OPT_IN_LABEL: Improve how Yin keeps you company over time (optional)
PRIVACY_SHEET_YPE_OPT_IN_HINT: Off by default. If you turn this on, we send a small set of structured signals from this device—such as focus completion, reflection frequency, your chosen companion style, and practice-day counts. We never send your Confide words or Yin's memory summaries. These signals are used to personalize how Yin keeps you company over time. Yin still works offline, and you can turn this off anytime.
PRIVACY_SHEET_YPE_OPT_IN_DETAIL_1: What leaves this device? Limited structured signals such as focus completion, reflection frequency, your chosen companion style and the interaction preferences associated with it, and practice-day counts.
PRIVACY_SHEET_YPE_OPT_IN_DETAIL_2: What stays on this device? Your Confide conversations, Yin's personal memories, and the text of what you say to Yin.
PRIVACY_SHEET_YPE_OPT_IN_DETAIL_3: Why is it used? To calculate long-term personalization patterns and send a small personalization state back to this device.
PRIVACY_SHEET_YPE_OPT_IN_DETAIL_4: What happens if I turn it off? No new signals are sent. The cloud personalization data tied to this choice is deleted. Any personalization pack cached on this device is discarded. Yin continues to work locally.
PRIVACY_SHEET_YPE_OPT_IN_DETAIL_5: Turning this off does not disable Yin, Focus, Confide, Memory, or other local features.
PRIVACY_SHEET_FUNNEL_OPT_IN_HINT: Off by default. If you turn this on, we send only Support → checkout step counts (no email, no reflections, no payment IDs) to our own server so we can improve the quiet support path. You can turn it off anytime.
